intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sailing through crystal-clear lagoons as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree views of the Indian Ocean. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable evening on the water.

experiences.name: House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays
experiences.description: Dive into the vibrant underwater world of the Maldives with a guided house reef snorkeling session renowned for manta ray sightings. Glide alongside these majestic creatures in their natural habitat, surrounded by colorful coral gardens, sea turtles, and tropical fish. Equipment is provided and a certified guide ensures a safe and magical experience for all skill levels.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in the ultimate luxury experience with a couples' spa treatment in a stunning semi-submerged or glass-floor overwater spa pavilion. Enjoy synchronized deep-tissue massages, aromatic scrubs, and flower baths while gazing at the turquoise lagoon beneath you. This world-class pampering session is the epitome of Maldivian luxury and romance.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and sweet bondi. The evening concludes with a cultural performance featuring traditional bodu beru drumming and dance, offering a rich and memorable glimpse into island heritage.

experiences.name: Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two
experiences.description: Wake up to an exclusive sunrise picnic on a secluded private sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise ocean and sky. A resort butler sets up a beautifully decorated table with freshly baked pastries, tropical fruits, eggs cooked to order, and sparkling juice. Spend the morning swimming, snorkeling the nearby reef, and soaking in the serene solitude — a truly once-in-a-lifetime honeymoon memory.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort via speedboat or dhoni transfer arranged by the resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort. Take a quiet stroll along the beachfront to soak in the night atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable - travel day
meals.lunch: Not applicable - travel day
meals.dinner: Grab a light late-night snack at the resort's casual beach bar or request a simple room service meal to keep costs low. Budget option: instant noodles or snacks packed from home for the first night.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with Aegean Bliss Resort in advance. Night transfers can be scenic but pack a light jacket as sea breeze can be cool. Keep travel documents easily accessible. Exchange some USD to MVR (Maldivian Rufiyaa) at the airport for small local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early to catch your first Maldivian sunrise from the beachfront. Explore the resort grounds and familiarize yourself with the layout. Take a leisurely swim in the crystal-clear lagoon right off the beach — completely free and one of the best experiences in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent snorkeling gear from the resort's water sports center (budget tip: ask about complimentary gear included in your stay). Head to the house reef just off the beachfront for your first snorkeling session. Spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations. Return to the beach for relaxation and sunbathing.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the stunning Maldivian sunset from the beach with a cold drink. Stroll along the shoreline hand-in-hand for a romantic evening atmosphere. Visit the resort's casual dining area for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet if included in your package, or opt for a budget-friendly local breakfast of roshi (flatbread) and black tea at the resort's casual cafe.
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic-style lunch from the resort's grab-and-go counter — sandwiches and fresh fruit to enjoy on the beach.
meals.dinner: Dine at the resort's casual beachside restaurant. Order local Maldivian dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut) or garudhiya (fish broth with rice) which are more affordable than Western menu options. Budget: $15–25 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort front desk about any free or complimentary activities available to guests. Many beachfront resorts offer complimentary kayaking, paddleboarding, or snorkeling gear — always ask before renting.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during the calmest water conditions. Look out for blacktip reef sharks and manta rays in the shallows. Bring an underwater camera or rent a waterproof GoPro from the resort to capture memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a self-guided exploration of the local island nearest to the resort (accessible by short dhoni ride or walking if connected). Visit the local market, explore narrow sandy streets, and interact with friendly Maldivian locals. Browse locally made handicrafts and woven lacquerware for budget-friendly souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a romantic beachfront dinner under the stars. Many resorts offer candlelit beach dinners — inquire if a budget-friendly version is available or set up your own romantic picnic on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop (sai hotel) on the nearby island — try hedhikaa (local savory snacks) and sweet black tea. Extremely budget-friendly at under $3.
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island restaurant for an authentic Maldivian curry meal with rice and fish. Budget: $5–8 per person — far cheaper than resort dining.
meals.dinner: Resort casual dining — order a shared seafood platter and a bottle of house wine if available. Budget: $30–40 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Always dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees as a sign of respect for the Muslim community. Bikinis are only appropriate on resort islands.

day_by_day.morning: Join a group snorkeling excursion organized by the resort or a local dive center. Group tours are significantly cheaper than private ones. Explore nearby coral reefs and snorkeling spots not accessible from the house reef. Look for vibrant parrotfish, Napoleon wrasse, and sea turtles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon relaxing on the beachfront. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) if complimentary or rent for a short session. Read a book in a hammock or beach lounger and enjoy the tropical ambiance.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free cultural show or Maldivian bodu beru (traditional drum) performance if offered by the resort. These are often complimentary and provide wonderful insight into local culture. Enjoy a romantic walk along the beach as bioluminescent plankton may light up the shoreline at night.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — stick to the buffet if included, or order a simple egg dish and fresh tropical fruit plate.
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — grilled fish sandwich and fresh coconut water from the resort's beach shack. Budget: $10–15.
meals.dinner: Try the resort's set menu dinner if available — these are often better value than ordering à la carte. Budget: $20–30 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Check with the resort about any upcoming cultural events or free evening entertainment. Bioluminescent plankton (sea fireflies) are most visible on very dark nights away from resort lights — ask staff for the best viewing spots.

day_by_day.morning: Rent a kayak from the resort's water sports center and paddle around the lagoon. Explore hidden sandbanks and shallow turquoise waters at your own pace. This is a wonderfully romantic and affordable activity for couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby sandbank (sandbank picnic trip) — arrange a budget group trip through the resort or a local guesthouse. Spend 2–3 hours on a pristine white sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise ocean. Perfect for romantic photos and swimming.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset fishing trip — join a group sunset fishing excursion on a traditional dhoni boat. This is a classic Maldivian experience and group rates keep costs manageable. Catch your own fish and have the resort cook it for you (small preparation fee may apply).

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter and yogurt from the resort cafe. Budget-friendly and energizing for an active day.
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic lunch for the sandbank trip — request a packed lunch box from the resort kitchen at a nominal charge, or bring snacks and water.
meals.dinner: Freshly cooked fish from your sunset fishing catch, prepared by the resort kitchen. Supplement with a simple rice and curry side dish. Budget: $15–20 for preparation plus any sides.

day_by_day.notes: Book the sandbank trip and sunset fishing excursion at least a day in advance. Group bookings with other resort guests can significantly reduce per-person costs. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water for the sandbank visit.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation session on the beach — many resorts offer complimentary sunrise yoga. This is a perfect way to connect with your surroundings and enjoy a peaceful romantic morning together.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the underwater world with a budget snorkeling trip to a nearby coral garden or fish feeding spot. Many local guides offer affordable half-day snorkeling tours that visit multiple reef sites. Spot eagle rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish.
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in a budget spa treatment — look for local massage therapists on nearby islands who offer traditional Maldivian massages at a fraction of resort spa prices. A 60-minute couples massage can be a romantic and affordable treat.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy mas huni (shredded smoked tuna with coconut and chili) with roshi flatbread, a traditional Maldivian breakfast staple.
meals.lunch: Local island teashop for a hearty fish curry lunch. Budget: $5–8 per person.
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try a fresh grilled catch of the day with steamed vegetables and rice. Simple, delicious, and more affordable than elaborate set menus. Budget: $20–25 per person.

day_by_day.notes: If the resort offers complimentary sunrise yoga, check the schedule at the front desk. For spa services, always ask for the price list upfront and compare resort spa prices with local island options before booking.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day island hopping adventure — book a group island hopping tour through a local tour operator (significantly cheaper than resort-organized private tours). Visit 2–3 different local islands, a resort island for snorkeling, and a sandbank.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour. Visit a local fishing village and observe traditional Maldivian boat building. Browse local craft shops for affordable handmade souvenirs like woven fans, lacquerware boxes, and shell jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort in the late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet romantic dinner at the resort to celebrate the midpoint of your trip.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure — toast, eggs, and coffee to fuel the day ahead.
meals.lunch: Lunch is typically included in island hopping tour packages — often a freshly grilled fish BBQ on a sandbank or at a local island restaurant.
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on a nicer resort dinner to mark the midpoint of your honeymoon. Share a seafood dish and a dessert. Budget: $35–50 for two.

day_by_day.notes: Book island hopping tours through local guesthouses or tour operators rather than directly through the resort for the best prices. A full-day group island hopping tour typically costs $40–70 per person including lunch, compared to $150+ for private resort tours.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning at the resort — sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Spend the morning lounging on the beachfront, swimming in the lagoon, and enjoying the peaceful tropical surroundings. This is your rest day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at a new spot on the house reef — explore a different section of the reef you haven't visited yet. Many house reefs are large enough to offer new discoveries each time. Look for octopus, moray eels, and colorful nudibranchs in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach picnic setup — ask the resort to arrange a simple beach picnic setup with candles and a bottle of sparkling juice or wine. Many resorts can arrange this at a lower cost than a formal private dining experience. Stargaze together on the beach afterward.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — take your time and enjoy the full spread. Fresh tropical juices, pastries, and a hot dish.
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — fresh fruit, cheese, crackers, and cold drinks from the resort's beach snack bar. Budget: $8–12.
meals.dinner: Romantic beach picnic arranged with the resort. Simple but magical — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit, local sweets, and drinks under the stars. Budget: $25–35 for two.

day_by_day.notes: A rest day is essential on a 13-day trip. Don't feel pressured to fill every moment with activities. Some of the most memorable Maldives moments come from simply sitting on the beach and watching the ocean. Inquire about beach picnic setup costs in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching cruise — join a group sunrise dolphin cruise on a traditional dhoni. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters in the early morning. This is a magical and budget-friendly experience when booked as a group tour.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's marine biology center or reef restoration project if available. Many resorts in the Maldives have coral regeneration programs that guests can participate in for free or a small fee — a meaningful and educational experience.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local cultural event or Maldivian cooking class if offered by the resort or a nearby local island. Learning to cook traditional dishes like garudhiya or mas huni is both fun and budget-friendly.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-dawn snack before the dolphin cruise — granola bar and coffee. Have a proper breakfast upon return.
meals.lunch: Local island restaurant for a fresh fish curry and rice lunch. Budget: $6–10 per person.
meals.dinner: Cook and enjoy the dishes you learned in the cooking class, or dine at the resort's casual restaurant. Budget: $15–20 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching cruises are best in the early morning. Group tours typically cost $25–40 per person. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens or a waterproof action camera. The Maldives is home to several dolphin species including spinner, bottlenose, and spotted dolphins.

day_by_day.morning: Snorkeling at a famous nearby reef or dive site — ask the resort to recommend the best snorkeling spots accessible by a short boat ride. Some of the best reef systems in the Maldives are just a 15–30 minute boat ride from most resorts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach volleyball or other free resort beach activities. Many resorts offer complimentary beach games, badminton, and water sports for guests. Enjoy a relaxed competitive game followed by a refreshing swim.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic sunset cruise on a traditional Maldivian dhoni — book a group sunset cruise for a budget-friendly option. Sip on fresh coconut water as you watch the sun melt into the Indian Ocean horizon.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — try something new from the menu today. Maldivian-style breakfast with tuna pastry (bajiya) and sweet tea.
meals.lunch: Beachside grilled fish wrap and fresh lime juice at the resort's beach shack. Budget: $10–15.
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — order a simple but satisfying grilled seafood dish. Complement with a shared dessert of tropical fruit sorbet. Budget: $25–35 for two.

day_by_day.notes: For the snorkeling excursion, always check sea conditions and visibility before heading out. March is generally an excellent month for snorkeling in the Maldives with good visibility and calm seas. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite reef spot or try a new location. Spend extra time underwater appreciating the incredible marine biodiversity. Take mental snapshots of the coral gardens, fish schools, and sea turtles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping on a nearby local island. Stock up on authentic Maldivian crafts, spices, and gifts for family and friends back home. Local markets offer the best prices — negotiate respectfully for better deals.
day_by_day.evening: Special anniversary/honeymoon dinner at the resort — treat yourselves to a slightly more indulgent meal to celebrate your trip. Many resorts offer special romantic dinner setups for couples at a reasonable cost when requested in advance.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy your favorite breakfast combination discovered during the trip.
meals.lunch: Local island lunch — fresh seafood plate with rice and salad at a local restaurant. Budget: $8–12 per person.
meals.dinner: Special couples dinner at the resort — request a beachfront table with candles. Order a fresh lobster or seafood platter to share as a special treat. Budget: $50–70 for two as a one-time splurge.

day_by_day.notes: For souvenir shopping, the best value items include handwoven lacquerware (laajehun), miniature dhoni boats, locally made coconut products, and Maldivian spice mixes. Avoid purchasing coral, shells, or any marine life products as these are environmentally harmful and may be illegal to export.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise photography session on the beach — capture the magical golden hour light over the Indian Ocean. This is one of the most beautiful and completely free experiences in the Maldives. Experiment with long exposure shots of the turquoise water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final lagoon swim and snorkeling session — say goodbye to the house reef and its inhabitants. Spend a couple of hours floating in the warm, clear water and cherishing the last full day in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Pack bags and prepare for departure the following day. Enjoy a final romantic walk along the beachfront at sunset. Visit the resort bar for a farewell cocktail and reflect on the incredible memories made during the trip.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — enjoy every last bite of the tropical spread.
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — fresh salad, grilled fish, and coconut water. Budget: $12–18.
meals.dinner: Final dinner at the resort's casual restaurant — order your favorite dish from the trip. Keep it simple and satisfying. Budget: $20–30 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time and transfer arrangements to the airport with the resort front desk. Arrange a speedboat or seaplane transfer for the following morning. Settle any outstanding bills at the resort to avoid a rushed checkout. Leave a thank-you note for the resort staff who made your stay special.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise. Take a final dip in the lagoon and collect a small jar of white sand as a free keepsake memory. Complete checkout formalities and ensure all luggage is ready.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Velana International Airport via speedboat or seaplane arranged by the resort. Arrive at the airport with sufficient time for check-in and departure procedures. Browse duty-free shops for any last-minute gifts — Maldivian vanilla, spices, or local honey make wonderful budget-friendly souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from the Maldives with a heart full of beautiful memories, a camera full of stunning photos, and a deep appreciation for one of the world's most breathtaking destinations. Reflect on your incredible 13-day budget honeymoon adventure.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — savor every last bite of tropical fruit, fresh pastries, and Maldivian tea.
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or cafe for a simple meal before departure. Budget: $10–15 per person.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tip: The key to a budget Maldives trip is staying at a guesthouse-style beachfront resort, eating at local island restaurants whenever possible, booking group tours instead of private excursions, and taking advantage of complimentary resort amenities. Total estimated daily budget per couple: $80–150/day excluding accommodation, compared to $500–1000+/day at luxury overwater bungalow resorts. The Maldives is magical at any budget level — the ocean, the snorkeling, and the romance are absolutely free.

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled – late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled – late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs, then meet your resort transfer representative. Board the speedboat or seaplane transfer arranged by Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, enjoy a welcome drink and light snack prepared by the resort, and settle in for the night.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable – in transit
meals.lunch: Not applicable – in transit
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack and tropical fruit platter provided by Aegean Bliss Resort upon check-in

day_by_day.notes: Keep carry-on essentials accessible for the transfer. Confirm speedboat or seaplane transfer timing with the resort before departure. The resort's 24-hour front desk will assist with any late-night needs. Rest well – your Maldives adventure begins tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take your first walk along the beachfront and soak in the stunning turquoise lagoon views from your villa. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed breakfast overlooking the ocean. Spend time familiarising yourself with the resort facilities, pool, and beach area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's activity desk to book upcoming experiences for the week. Spend the afternoon relaxing on your private beachfront, take a gentle swim in the warm lagoon, or lounge by the resort pool with a tropical cocktail. Explore the resort's boutique shops and spa menu for future bookings.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner at the resort's signature restaurant. Watch the sunset paint the sky in shades of orange and pink from the beach before dinner. After dinner, take a moonlit stroll along the shoreline and enjoy the bioluminescent plankton if conditions allow.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant – tropical fruits, eggs, pastries, and local Maldivian dishes
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach bar – grilled fish wraps, fresh salads, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's signature beachside restaurant – grilled lobster or fresh catch of the day with a bottle of house wine

day_by_day.notes: This is your orientation and recovery day after the late arrival. Don't over-schedule – let the island pace wash over you. Apply sunscreen generously as the Maldivian sun is intense even in March.

day_by_day.morning: Exclusive Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two – Rise before sunrise and be transferred by a small boat to a secluded private sandbank. Enjoy a beautifully curated breakfast spread surrounded by nothing but turquoise waters, white sand, and a breathtaking sunrise. Toast with fresh juice and enjoy the absolute tranquility of having your own private island for the morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and gear up for your first snorkeling session at the house reef. Collect snorkeling equipment from the dive center and spend the afternoon exploring the colorful coral gardens just steps from your beachfront villa. Look out for parrotfish, angelfish, and sea turtles in the shallow reef sections.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne – Board a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat for a romantic private sunset cruise. Sail through crystal-clear waters as the sun dips below the horizon, sipping chilled champagne and enjoying canapés. Watch for dolphins that frequently follow dhoni boats in the evening hours.

meals.breakfast: Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two – curated spread of pastries, tropical fruits, smoked salmon, yogurt parfaits, and fresh juices on a private sandbank
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's overwater bar – sushi rolls, prawn tempura, and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's à la carte restaurant upon return from the dhoni cruise – Maldivian curry with roshi bread and a dessert platter for two

day_by_day.notes: The Sandbank Picnic Breakfast must be booked in advance through the resort concierge – confirm the previous evening. Bring your camera and a light wrap for the sandbank morning as it can be breezy. The dhoni cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours.

day_by_day.morning: House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays – Join a guided snorkeling session led by an expert marine biologist from the resort. Explore the vibrant house reef with the chance to encounter majestic manta rays gliding gracefully through the water. Your guide will point out rare marine species including reef sharks, eagle rays, and exotic tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the exhilarating morning snorkel, return to your beachfront villa for a private lunch. Spend the afternoon in complete relaxation – read a book in your beach hammock, take a nap in the shade of a palm tree, or enjoy a refreshing dip in your private stretch of beach. Alternatively, rent a kayak or stand-up paddleboard from the water sports center.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy sundowners at the resort's overwater bar, watching the sky turn golden. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed dinner and perhaps try the local Maldivian tuna curry for an authentic taste of the islands.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast delivered to your beachfront – continental spread with fresh juices, eggs to order, and local Maldivian short eats
meals.lunch: Beachside BBQ at the resort's grill – freshly caught tuna steaks, grilled vegetables, and tropical fruit salad
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant – Maldivian mas riha (tuna curry) with steamed rice, followed by coconut panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are highly likely in March as this is peak season in the Maldives. Wear reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling session – the resort may also offer underwater photography services.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two – Indulge in the ultimate luxury experience at the resort's semi-submerged underwater spa. Enjoy a couples' treatment in a stunning glass-walled treatment room with panoramic views of the ocean floor. Choose from deep tissue massages, aromatherapy treatments, or a traditional Maldivian Kandu body wrap using local coconut and sea salt.
day_by_day.afternoon: After your spa morning, enjoy a leisurely poolside afternoon. Order cocktails and light bites from the pool bar and simply unwind. If you're feeling active, join a complimentary resort activity such as a sunset yoga session on the beach or a guided island nature walk to learn about the local flora and fauna.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening – Immerse yourselves in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes like garudhiya fish soup, mas huni, and bis keemiya. Enjoy the fruits of your labor over a communal dinner with cultural storytelling and traditional music performance.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant – fuel up before your spa morning with a hearty spread
meals.lunch: Poolside light bites – club sandwiches, fresh fruit skewers, and smoothie bowls
meals.dinner: Your own creations from the Maldivian Cooking Class – traditional dishes prepared by you, paired with local herbal teas and fresh lime juice

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance as it is the most popular experience at the resort and slots fill quickly. The cooking class is a wonderful cultural experience – bring an appetite and an open mind to trying new flavors. Request a vegetarian version of the cooking class if preferred.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach (complimentary with resort stay). Afterward, take a long romantic walk along the entire stretch of the resort's beachfront, collecting shells and enjoying the morning calm before other guests are up. Swim in the warm lagoon and watch the fish in the shallows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day snorkeling excursion to a nearby reef system a short boat ride from the resort. This outer reef offers different marine life than the house reef – expect larger schools of fish, moray eels, and possibly whale sharks depending on the season. The resort's dive center organizes regular afternoon reef trips.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private in-villa romantic dinner set up on your beachfront by the resort team. Dine under the stars with your feet in the sand, fairy lights strung overhead, and a personalized menu prepared by the resort's chef. This is the perfect evening for a honeymoon celebration dinner.

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at the resort café – acai bowls, granola, fresh coconut, and green smoothies after yoga
meals.lunch: Packed snack box provided by the resort for the reef snorkeling excursion – sandwiches, fruit, and water
meals.dinner: Private in-villa romantic beachfront dinner – five-course set menu with lobster thermidor, champagne sorbet, and chocolate lava cake for dessert

day_by_day.notes: The private beachfront dinner must be arranged at least 24 hours in advance through the resort concierge. Specify any dietary requirements or a special occasion message. This dinner may come at an additional premium but is well worth it for a honeymoon. Bring mosquito repellent for the evening outdoor dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of your trip – take a relaxing morning entirely at your own pace. Order room service breakfast to your beachfront villa and enjoy it on your private terrace. Spend time journaling, reading, or simply sitting in silence listening to the waves. This is your true digital detox morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local inhabited island nearby for a cultural excursion. The resort can arrange a short speedboat transfer to a local Maldivian village where you can explore the island on foot, visit a local school or mosque, browse handmade crafts and lacquerwork at small shops, and interact with friendly local residents.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Head to the resort's overwater bar for happy hour cocktails and watch the sunset. Enjoy a casual dinner at the resort's beach grill with a fresh seafood platter and chilled white wine.

meals.breakfast: In-villa room service – eggs benedict, fresh tropical juice, and Maldivian hedhikaa (local short eats)
meals.lunch: Local tea house on the inhabited island – freshly brewed Maldivian black tea with local short eats like gulha (fish balls) and keemia
meals.dinner: Beach grill dinner at the resort – mixed seafood platter with grilled prawns, calamari, and reef fish with garlic butter sauce

day_by_day.notes: The local island visit offers a genuine glimpse into everyday Maldivian life beyond the resort bubble – a meaningful and grounding experience mid-honeymoon. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (cover shoulders and knees out of respect). Bring some cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD for small purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Second House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays session – Return to the house reef at a different time of day (morning light is spectacular for underwater visibility). Focus on deeper sections of the reef where larger marine life tends to congregate. Ask your guide about night snorkeling possibilities for later in the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with panoramic ocean views. Order afternoon cocktails and enjoy the stunning vista. Treat yourself to a light spa treatment – perhaps a 30-minute foot massage or scalp treatment at the resort spa to complement your full couples' treatment earlier in the trip.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne – If you loved the first cruise, this second sailing takes a different route around the atoll, offering new perspectives and potentially different wildlife encounters including spinner dolphins. Watch the stars emerge as twilight falls on the open ocean.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant – fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian mas huni with roshi, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant lunch – prawn linguine, fresh garden salad, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's fine dining restaurant – tasting menu with paired wines featuring locally inspired dishes with international techniques

day_by_day.notes: If manta rays were not sighted on Day 4, this morning session provides another excellent opportunity. March is one of the best months for manta ray encounters in the Maldives. The tasting menu dinner is a mid-range splurge but an excellent culinary experience – reserve in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Try a new water sport – take a beginner's scuba diving discovery session with the resort's PADI-certified dive center. Even without certification, a resort dive allows you to descend to 5–8 meters with an instructor, opening up a completely new perspective on the underwater world compared to snorkeling. Alternatively, try freediving if scuba isn't appealing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a couple's hammock afternoon strung between two palm trees on your private beachfront. Alternatively, visit the resort's library and games room for a rainy-day style afternoon of board games and reading if you need a break from the sun. Enjoy afternoon tea served by the resort at 4 PM – a lovely Maldivian tradition.
day_by_day.evening: Join the resort's stargazing experience if offered, or simply lay on the beach after dinner and marvel at the Milky Way visible in the Maldives' minimal light pollution skies. Enjoy a nightcap at the overwater bar before retiring.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the dive – fresh fruit, toast, and juice (avoid heavy meals before diving)
meals.lunch: Post-dive hearty lunch at the resort restaurant – grilled chicken or fish with rice and a fresh vegetable curry
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beach bar – wood-fired pizza, fresh salads, and a shared dessert board

day_by_day.notes: The discovery dive session typically costs extra and lasts 2–3 hours including briefing. No prior experience is needed but inform the instructor of any medical conditions. The Maldives offers some of the best visibility for beginner divers in the world. Stargazing is best away from resort lighting – ask the concierge about dark sky spots on the island.

day_by_day.morning: Second Underwater Spa Treatment for Two – Return to the semi-submerged underwater spa for a different treatment. This time, opt for a traditional Maldivian Kandu hot stone therapy or a couples' facial using local coconut and sea botanicals. The underwater setting never loses its magic and this second visit lets you fully relax without the novelty distraction.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's coral restoration program if available – many Maldivian resorts run marine conservation projects where guests can participate in planting coral frames on the reef. This meaningful afternoon activity contributes to the health of the reef you've been snorkeling on all week.
day_by_day.evening: Revisit the Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening for a second session focusing on desserts and beverages – learn to make bondibaiy (rice pudding) and dhonkeyo kajuru (banana fritters) and brew authentic Maldivian sap tea. Enjoy the cultural performance again with fresh eyes.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast – fresh smoothie bowls, eggs, and local pastries delivered to your terrace
meals.lunch: Spa lunch menu – light and healthy options including avocado toast, quinoa salad, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Resort's themed island night buffet (if available on Wednesdays) – a spread of Maldivian, Asian, and international dishes with live music and cultural performances

day_by_day.notes: Check with the resort about their coral restoration or marine conservation programs – participation is usually complimentary or at a small donation. This is a deeply meaningful activity that adds purpose to your holiday. The island night buffet is a wonderful social dining experience – a nice change from intimate dinners.

day_by_day.morning: Second Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two – Return to the private sandbank but this time stay longer and bring snorkeling gear. After breakfast, snorkel directly off the sandbank edge where the sand drops away into deep blue water – an exhilarating and unique snorkeling experience far from the main reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your second-to-last full afternoon exactly as you wish – this is your free afternoon. Suggestions include: a final kayak paddle around the lagoon, a couples' photoshoot arranged through the resort's photography service to capture honeymoon memories, or simply lying on the beach doing absolutely nothing.
day_by_day.evening: Splurge on a farewell-style overwater dining experience – many Maldivian resorts offer dining on a private jetty or overwater platform. Request this special setup for your penultimate evening. Dress up and enjoy a long, lingering dinner over the ocean as the stars reflect in the water below.

meals.breakfast: Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two – upgraded spread with sparkling wine, artisan cheeses, and fresh-baked croissants
meals.lunch: Resort beach café – light mezze-style lunch with hummus, grilled flatbreads, and fresh fish ceviche
meals.dinner: Private overwater jetty dinner – four-course set menu with fresh lobster bisque, pan-seared reef fish, and a romantic dessert for two

day_by_day.notes: Book the overwater jetty dinner at least 48 hours in advance as it requires special setup by the resort team. Consider hiring the resort's underwater photographer for the morning sandbank snorkeling session – the photos will be treasured memories. Begin packing non-essentials this evening to ease tomorrow's final day.

day_by_day.morning: Final House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays – Your last morning snorkel session. Take your time and say goodbye to the marine world you've come to know over the past 12 days. Swim slowly, observe quietly, and appreciate the extraordinary privilege of snorkeling in one of the world's most pristine marine environments.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final resort afternoon – visit every favorite spot one last time. Take a last swim in the lagoon, order your favorite cocktail at the overwater bar, collect a small amount of sand in a bottle as a keepsake, and browse the resort boutique for meaningful souvenirs and gifts. Pack your bags fully.
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner at the resort – return to your favorite restaurant from the trip. Reflect on the incredible 12 days you've shared, toast to your honeymoon and future together, and savor every last bite. After dinner, enjoy one final moonlit beach walk before an early night ahead of tomorrow's departure.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast – load up on all your favorites from the past two weeks
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch – your favorite dish from the trip, enjoyed one last time with your toes in the sand
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at your favorite resort restaurant – order your most memorable dishes from the trip and celebrate with a special dessert

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer details with the resort concierge today. Settle any outstanding bills and ensure all resort charges are reviewed. Leave a review or thank-you note for exceptional staff members who made your honeymoon special. Set an early alarm if your departure transfer is in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on your beachfront – wake up early for one last sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your villa terrace. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort and complete any last-minute packing. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort and board your transfer back to Velana International Airport, carrying with you the memories of an unforgettable 13-day Maldivian honeymoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure – depending on your outbound flight time, explore the airport's duty-free shopping for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs including local lacquerwork, coconut products, and spices. Board your return flight home.
day_by_day.evening: In transit home – relive your favorite memories, review your photos, and begin planning your next adventure together.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast – a leisurely last meal at Aegean Bliss Resort
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge – light meal before departure
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Check-out time is typically 12:00 noon – arrange a late check-out (until 14:00 or 16:00) if your flight departs in the afternoon, usually available for a small fee or complimentary based on resort policy. The speedboat transfer to the airport takes approximately 20–45 minutes depending on your resort's location. Allow ample time for check-in and security at Velana International Airport.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sailing through crystal-clear lagoons as the sun dips below the horizon. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree views of the Indian Ocean. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate and unforgettable evening on the water.

experiences.name: House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays
experiences.description: Dive into the vibrant underwater world of the Maldives with a guided house reef snorkeling session renowned for manta ray sightings. Glide alongside these majestic creatures in their natural habitat, surrounded by colorful coral gardens, sea turtles, and tropical fish. Equipment is provided and a certified guide ensures a safe and magical experience for all skill levels.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in the ultimate luxury experience with a couples' spa treatment in a stunning semi-submerged or glass-floor overwater spa pavilion. Enjoy synchronized deep-tissue massages, aromatic scrubs, and flower baths while gazing at the turquoise lagoon beneath you. This world-class pampering session is the epitome of Maldivian luxury and romance.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and sweet bondi. The evening concludes with a cultural performance featuring traditional bodu beru drumming and dance, offering a rich and memorable glimpse into island heritage.

experiences.name: Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two
experiences.description: Wake up to an exclusive sunrise picnic on a secluded private sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise ocean and sky. A resort butler sets up a beautifully decorated table with freshly baked pastries, tropical fruits, eggs cooked to order, and sparkling juice. Spend the morning swimming, snorkeling the nearby reef, and soaking in the serene solitude — a truly once-in-a-lifetime honeymoon memory.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Resort representative meets you at the arrival hall for a seamless VIP transfer. Enjoy a private speedboat or seaplane transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Upon arrival, indulge in a traditional Maldivian welcome with chilled towels, fresh coconut water, and a fragrant flower garland. Private butler escorts you to your Beachfront Villa for a late-night turndown experience with rose petals, ambient lighting, and a complimentary bottle of chilled Champagne awaiting you.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Light welcome amenity platter prepared by the resort — tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, smoked salmon canapés, and Champagne served in-villa upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, all Day 1 activities are post-arrival only. Confirm speedboat or seaplane transfer schedule with the resort in advance. Seaplanes do not operate after dark, so a speedboat night transfer will be arranged. Luggage handling is fully managed by the butler team. Rest well — your Maldives adventure begins tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning to recover from travel. Around 9:30 AM, savor a lavish in-villa breakfast served on your private deck overlooking the turquoise lagoon. Take a gentle stroll along the resort's pristine beachfront, get acquainted with your villa's infinity pool, and meet your dedicated butler to plan the days ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation snorkel session at the House Reef — a guided introduction to the resort's vibrant coral gardens with a certified snorkel guide. Spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and exotic coral formations just steps from your villa. Equipment is provided, and the guide ensures a safe, memorable first underwater experience in the Maldives.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into the resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant for a romantic candlelit dinner. Watch the sun melt into the Indian Ocean from your table as you sip handcrafted cocktails and enjoy the evening breeze.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private breakfast on the deck — freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs Benedict, Maldivian roshi flatbread, fresh fruit platters, and barista-prepared coffee
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled lobster rolls, fresh tuna tartare, and chilled coconut water
meals.dinner: Signature overwater restaurant — 4-course à la carte dinner featuring seared scallops, mahi-mahi with saffron bisque, and a decadent chocolate fondant paired with a curated wine selection

day_by_day.notes: This day is intentionally relaxed to allow recovery from travel fatigue. Inform the butler of any dietary preferences or allergies so the culinary team can personalize all future dining experiences. Request a villa orientation tour from the butler to maximize use of in-villa amenities.

day_by_day.morning: Exclusive Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two — your butler and a private boat captain whisk you away at sunrise to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank surrounded by nothing but crystal-clear turquoise water and open sky. A bespoke gourmet breakfast is laid out on a linen-draped table with fresh pastries, tropical fruits, Champagne, and freshly brewed coffee. Wade in the warm shallows and soak in the absolute serenity of this once-in-a-lifetime experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge by your private villa pool, enjoy the resort's spa relaxation lounge, or explore the resort's boutique. Optional: book a couples' massage at the overwater spa (standard treatment, saving the signature underwater spa for later in the trip).
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's beachfront Mediterranean-inspired restaurant under the stars. Soft torchlight, the sound of gentle waves, and an expertly crafted menu make for an unforgettable romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank picnic breakfast — Champagne, smoked salmon croissants, tropical fruit skewers, Greek yogurt with honey, and freshly brewed Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Light in-villa lunch — grilled prawn salad, fresh watermelon gazpacho, and sparkling water served poolside
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant — wood-fired Mediterranean mezze, pan-seared sea bass, and a shared baklava dessert with rose water ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic must be pre-booked through your butler at least 24 hours in advance. Tides and weather conditions may affect sandbank accessibility — the resort will confirm the best timing. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a camera for the sandbank visit.

day_by_day.morning: House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays — join a guided snorkeling expedition to the resort's renowned house reef and nearby manta ray cleaning stations. A certified marine biologist guide leads the session, providing fascinating insights into manta ray behavior and reef ecology. Snorkel alongside these majestic creatures in their natural habitat — an awe-inspiring and deeply romantic shared experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-snorkel relaxation at the resort's adults-only infinity pool with panoramic ocean views. Enjoy signature cocktails from the pool bar — try the resort's famous 'Maldivian Sunset' cocktail made with local toddy and passion fruit. In the late afternoon, visit the resort's marine education center to learn about coral conservation efforts.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — embark on a romantic private cruise aboard a beautifully decorated traditional Maldivian dhoni boat. Sail through crystalline waters as the sky transforms into a canvas of gold, pink, and violet. Sip vintage Champagne, enjoy a curated canapé platter, and watch for dolphins playing in the boat's wake.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant buffet breakfast — live egg station, fresh-baked pastries, tropical fruit selection, Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), and premium coffee bar
meals.lunch: Poolside dining — lobster club sandwich, chilled mango and avocado salad, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Post-cruise in-villa private dinner — butler-served 3-course dinner on your deck with candles and flower arrangements: prawn bisque, grilled Maldivian reef fish, and a passion fruit panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: The manta ray snorkeling session is subject to marine conditions and manta ray presence, which is most reliable from November to April — March is an excellent time. The dhoni cruise departs approximately 90 minutes before sunset; confirm exact timing with your butler based on the day's sunset schedule. Life jackets and snorkel gear are provided for all water activities.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — indulge in the resort's crown jewel wellness experience: a couples' spa treatment in a stunning semi-submerged underwater treatment room where you can watch tropical fish glide past floor-to-ceiling glass panels while expert therapists perform a synchronised deep-tissue and aromatherapy massage. This 90-minute session is the ultimate fusion of luxury, romance, and nature.
day_by_day.afternoon: After your spa journey, enjoy a wellness lunch at the resort's health-focused restaurant. Spend the rest of the afternoon in peaceful relaxation — read on your villa's sun deck, take a gentle kayak paddle along the lagoon, or simply float in your private pool.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening — immerse yourselves in authentic Maldivian culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (tuna curry), and hedhikaa (local sweet snacks). The evening culminates in a cultural performance featuring traditional Bodu Beru drumming and dance.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — light pre-spa meal of fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, herbal teas, and whole grain toast with avocado
meals.lunch: Wellness restaurant — cold-pressed juices, quinoa and grilled vegetable bowl, and a detox coconut and ginger soup
meals.dinner: Enjoy the dishes you prepared during the cooking class in a communal dining setting with the chef, paired with local fruit juices and a curated wine selection

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment must be booked in advance — request your butler to secure the earliest available slot. Avoid heavy meals before the spa session. The cooking class typically accommodates 2–6 guests; it may be arranged as a fully private experience for an additional fee. Wear comfortable clothing for the cultural evening.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the beach led by the resort's private wellness instructor — a peaceful, grounding way to begin the day. Follow with a guided meditation on the shoreline as the sun climbs over the horizon, casting golden light across the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's watersports center — try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) across the calm lagoon, or take a glass-bottom kayak tour to observe the reef below without getting wet. In the mid-afternoon, enjoy a private catamaran sailing lesson with the resort's experienced sailing instructor.
day_by_day.evening: Elegant dinner at the resort's exclusive Chef's Table experience — a curated 7-course tasting menu prepared tableside by the executive chef, featuring the finest locally sourced seafood and imported premium ingredients, paired with a sommelier-selected wine flight.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga breakfast at the beach restaurant — acai bowls, smashed avocado on sourdough, fresh-pressed green juice, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch — freshly grilled catch of the day with herb butter, tropical slaw, and chilled sparkling water with lime
meals.dinner: Chef's Table 7-course tasting menu — highlights include Maldivian lobster bisque, seared yellowfin tuna tataki, wagyu beef tenderloin, and a signature chocolate and sea salt dessert with Champagne pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Chef's Table experience is highly exclusive and seats only 2–4 guests — book well in advance through your butler. Yoga and meditation sessions can be arranged at any time; early morning (6:30–7:30 AM) is recommended for the most serene experience. Watersports equipment is complimentary for resort guests.

day_by_day.morning: Full day of leisure — midpoint of the trip, designed for pure relaxation and indulgence. Begin with a slow morning: sleep in, enjoy a leisurely in-villa breakfast, and spend time simply being present in your stunning beachfront villa. Take a long walk along the beach collecting shells and watching the tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples' afternoon at the resort's overwater spa — book a 60-minute hot stone massage followed by a traditional Maldivian Coconut Scrub treatment to rejuvenate sun-kissed skin. Afterward, relax in the spa's private couples' lounge with herbal teas and tropical fruit.
day_by_day.evening: Surprise romantic setup arranged by your butler — a private beach dinner for two on a torch-lit stretch of sand, with a table set amid floating candles, fresh flowers, and soft ambient music. A dedicated private waiter serves a bespoke 4-course menu designed by the chef.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — Eggs Royale, smoked salmon and cream cheese bagels, fresh tropical fruit, and barista coffee
meals.lunch: In-villa poolside lunch — grilled prawn skewers, cold soba noodle salad, and fresh watermelon juice
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner — amuse-bouche, Maldivian crab bisque, pan-seared grouper with truffle risotto, and a shared strawberry and Champagne dessert

day_by_day.notes: This is intentionally a rest-and-recharge day — no structured excursions. Arrange the private beach dinner setup at least 48 hours in advance through your butler for the most personalized experience. Request rose petals, a specific music playlist, or any other romantic touches to make the evening uniquely yours.

day_by_day.morning: Advanced House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays — a second, more in-depth guided snorkeling session focusing on deeper reef sections and nocturnal marine life that can be spotted in early morning waters. The marine biologist guide takes you to a different section of the reef to discover new species, including reef sharks, eagle rays, and vibrant coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local Maldivian island by private speedboat — experience authentic island life, visit a local school or community workshop, browse handcrafted souvenirs at local shops, and enjoy a freshly prepared local tea snack (hedhikaa) at a traditional teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar, then dine at the resort's Japanese-inspired teppanyaki restaurant for a theatrical and delicious dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Pre-snorkel breakfast at the resort restaurant — light continental spread: yogurt, granola, fresh fruit, and green tea
meals.lunch: Local island teahouse lunch — authentic Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa): bajiya (fish pastry), gulha (fish balls), and fresh king coconut water
meals.dinner: Teppanyaki restaurant — chef-prepared Wagyu beef, Maldivian lobster tail, and seasonal vegetables with sake pairing and miso soup

day_by_day.notes: The local island excursion should be arranged through the resort concierge. Dress modestly when visiting local islands out of respect for the community (shoulders and knees covered). Photography of locals should always be done with permission. The teppanyaki restaurant is lively and entertaining — perfect for a fun, interactive evening.

day_by_day.morning: Private Sunrise Fishing Excursion — join a traditional Maldivian fishing experience at dawn aboard a private dhoni. Try your hand at handline fishing using traditional techniques, guided by an experienced local fisherman. The serene pre-dawn ocean, the rising sun, and the thrill of the catch make this a uniquely memorable morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort with your catch, which the resort chef will prepare as a bespoke lunch dish for you. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge in your villa's hammock over the water, enjoy a solo snorkel along the shallow lagoon, or browse the resort's curated boutique.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne (second experience, different route) — this evening, the dhoni takes a longer route toward a dolphin-watching hotspot. Watch spinner dolphins leap and play in the warm Indian Ocean waters as the sky turns crimson, sipping Champagne and sharing the magic of the moment.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before fishing — fresh fruit, energy bars, and thermos coffee prepared by the butler
meals.lunch: Chef-prepared lunch using your morning catch — pan-fried fresh fish with lemon butter, herb salad, and roasted vegetables served at the resort's beach restaurant
meals.dinner: In-villa romantic dinner — butler-served 3-course meal: burrata with heirloom tomatoes, grilled Maldivian lobster with garlic and herbs, and a dark chocolate lava cake with vanilla bean ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The fishing excursion departs very early (approximately 5:30–6:00 AM) — confirm timing and departure point with your butler the night before. Bring motion sickness medication if needed. Dolphin sightings on the dhoni cruise are common but not guaranteed — the captain will navigate to the best known locations.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cooking Class and Cultural Evening — Part Two (Desserts and Beverages Focus): Return to the kitchen for a second culinary session focused on Maldivian sweet treats and traditional beverages. Learn to make bondi (sweet rice balls), dhiya hakuru (palm sugar syrup desserts), and the traditional Maldivian raa (palm toddy-inspired mocktail). A truly immersive cultural morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at the resort's private beach — set up a luxury cabana with your butler's assistance, complete with chilled towels, personalized cocktails, and a curated snack platter. Enjoy a leisurely swim in the lagoon, build sandcastles, or simply lie back and listen to the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing experience on the sandbank — your resort arranges a private nighttime boat transfer to the sandbank where a telescope, star maps, and a knowledgeable guide await. Identify constellations, planets, and the Milky Way in the Maldives' remarkably dark and clear skies. Warm blankets and hot chocolate are provided.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant — full buffet breakfast with live cooking stations, fresh juices, and Maldivian specialties
meals.lunch: Private beach cabana lunch — gourmet sandwiches, a charcuterie and cheese board, tropical fruit platter, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Post-stargazing in-villa dinner — light but luxurious: truffle pasta, a mixed seafood platter, and a chilled dessert of mango sorbet with coconut foam

day_by_day.notes: The stargazing experience is weather-dependent — clear skies are common in March. Confirm the evening's weather outlook with the resort. Bring insect repellent for the sandbank at night. The cooking class Part Two should be pre-arranged with the resort's culinary team — it may be combined with the first session or offered as a standalone experience.

day_by_day.morning: Full-morning snorkeling safari by private boat — venture beyond the house reef to explore two or three of the region's most celebrated snorkeling sites, including a coral garden, a shark nursery, and a sea turtle feeding ground. The private boat ensures flexibility, intimacy, and the best possible experience tailored entirely to your preferences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a luxurious afternoon at the overwater spa — book the resort's signature 'Ocean Renewal' couple's package: a 2-hour treatment combining a Maldivian coconut and lime body wrap, a deep-tissue massage, and a revitalizing facial, all performed in the semi-submerged treatment room.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell-eve celebration dinner at the resort's premier overwater fine-dining restaurant — reserve the best table with the most panoramic ocean view. Order from the chef's special tasting menu and toast to an extraordinary journey with a bottle of vintage Champagne.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — light and energizing: fresh fruit, Greek yogurt with granola, smoked salmon on rye, and cold brew coffee
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet picnic lunch enjoyed on the private boat during the snorkeling safari — lobster wraps, fresh fruit, energy bars, and chilled sparkling water
meals.dinner: Overwater fine-dining restaurant — 5-course tasting menu: Maldivian ceviche, saffron lobster bisque, pan-seared tuna with wasabi cream, Wagyu beef tenderloin, and a spectacular shared dessert platter with Champagne

day_by_day.notes: The snorkeling safari boat should be arranged 24–48 hours in advance. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro to capture the diverse marine life. Apply reef-safe sunscreen generously before and during the safari. The spa package on Day 11 may be combined with the Day 5 Underwater Spa experience — confirm availability and any package deals with the spa reception.

day_by_day.morning: Final Sandbank Picnic Breakfast for Two — a beautiful bookend to the trip, revisiting the magical sandbank at sunrise. This time, the butler arranges a slightly different setup with sparkling rosé, a personalized keepsake (a framed photo from your trip or a handwritten letter from the resort team), and your favorite breakfast items selected from your preferences gathered throughout the stay.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon — final swim in the villa's private pool, a last snorkel along the house reef, and unhurried packing. Visit the resort's boutique to pick up premium Maldivian souvenirs: handcrafted lacquerware, local vanilla, and artisan jewellery. Enjoy a farewell cocktail at the overwater bar.
day_by_day.evening: Intimate in-villa farewell dinner — your butler coordinates a final private dinner on your deck, recreating your favorite elements from the trip: the ambiance of the beach dinner, the dishes you loved most, and a personalized dessert with a 'Thank You for Visiting' message crafted by the pastry chef.

meals.breakfast: Sandbank picnic — sparkling rosé, smoked salmon and cream cheese on blinis, fresh tropical fruit, and Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Beachside farewell lunch at the resort's main restaurant — order your favorite dishes from the week: grilled lobster, fresh tuna tartare, and a mango dessert
meals.dinner: In-villa private farewell dinner — personalized 4-course menu based on your favorite dishes from the trip, with a complimentary bottle of Champagne from the resort as a farewell gift

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing on the morning of Day 12 to avoid a rushed departure on Day 13. Confirm departure transfer details with your butler — speedboat timing to Malé must align with your outbound flight schedule. Request a late checkout if your flight allows. The resort may offer a keepsake gift or photo album as a farewell gesture — inquire with the butler.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on your villa's deck — wake early for one last breathtaking Maldivian sunrise. Enjoy a light farewell breakfast before the butler assists with luggage and escorts you to the resort's private jetty for your departure transfer to Malé International Airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure transfer — private speedboat to Malé International Airport. The resort's VIP concierge team manages all logistics, ensuring a smooth, stress-free departure. Arrive at the airport with ample time for check-in and enjoy the airport's premium lounge before your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry with you 13 days of extraordinary memories, a deeper connection with each other, and the timeless beauty of the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Light farewell breakfast on the villa deck — fresh fruit, yogurt, pastries, and your preferred coffee or tea, served by your butler one final time
meals.lunch: Airport lounge or onboard dining depending on flight schedule
meals.dinner: Onboard or at destination

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat departure time with the butler the night before — transfers to Malé typically take 30–90 minutes depending on resort location, and you should arrive at the airport at least 2–3 hours before your international flight. Settle any outstanding resort charges the evening before departure to avoid morning delays. Ensure all passports, tickets, and valuables are securely packed and accessible. The resort will provide a personalized farewell package with local treats and a handwritten note for the journey home.
